tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions asper the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must upload either the Firm Registration Certificate, or a certificate of registration issued by an appropriate Government Department, such as the Company Incorporation Certificate or MSME Registration Certificate

The bidder must upload a self-declaration stating that the tenderer has not been blacklisted by any Government Department, Quasi-Government Organization, or Public Sector Undertaking, and is not facing any judicial enquiry and will not supply Refurbished materials.
The bidder has to upload the copy of the PAN Card.
The bidder must upload a copy of the GST Registration Certificate along with the documents of the recent GST return paid challan for the financial year 2025-26
Technical Specifications should be filled (compulsorily with model no, part no and if any other required details), signed, and submitted as per Section VI.
Printed literature, catalogues and brochure in English of the quoted model including complete details should be uploaded.
Tender bid offer form Section - VIII document duly filled signed and uploaded by the tenderer.

Proforma statement of the orders up to at least 80% for the primary manufacturer and up to at least 30% for the authorized representative/agent of a manufacturer of the scheduled requirement of the tender for the Filter Papers in any one of last three years (2 years for Micro and Small Enterprises) (i.e., 2023-24 2024-25, 2025-2026) in Section XII and the Performance Statement / Satisfactory Certificates of the same should be submitted

If the tenderer is the primary manufacturer, the declaration of primary manufacturer in Section - XV as applicable to be submitted. If the tenderer is other than the primary manufacturer, the Authorization letter from the Primary manufacturer should be in the format provided as per Section - XIII to be submitted.
Information in Section - XIV Proforma for equipment / items and quality control employed by the manufacturer to be submitted.
Income tax returns statements for the last three financial years i.e. 2023-24 2024-25, 2025-2026 should be uploaded (income tax return acknowledgement copies).

The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be minimum of rupees 8 Lakh (it will be 50% with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises) for each of the three financial years i.e. 2023-24 2024-25, 2025-2026 (last 2 preceding financial years with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises) and certified by a chartered accountant, copy of the annual turnover declaration by a chartered accountant should be submitted.
